about.title: Buena Park Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Eight people died in traffic collisions in Buena Park during 2025, according to public records. Behind each of those numbers is a household in Orange County trying to figure out what comes next. Some of those crashes happened along Beach Boulevard, on the SR-91, or where La Palma Avenue and Western Avenue carry heavy Friday afternoon traffic. Others were not traffic related at all — a fall at a worksite, a defective product, a mistake in medical care. California law treats every one of them the same way: if someone's negligence or wrongful act caused the death, the family may bring a civil wrongful death claim. That claim is separate from any criminal case the Orange County District Attorney might pursue, and it can move forward whether or not charges are ever filed. LawProactive exists to take one task off your plate. Tell us what happened, and we will connect you, at no charge, with an independent attorney who handles wrongful death matters in Buena Park. From there, the conversation is between you and that attorney.

whyChoose.title: What a Wrongful Death Attorney Can Clarify for Your Family

items.title: Who Has the Right to File
items.desc: California limits standing in wrongful death cases: a surviving spouse or domestic partner and children come first, followed by certain dependents and heirs. An attorney can sort out who in your family is eligible before anything is filed.

items.title: The Clock Is Already Running
items.desc: Most wrongful death claims in California must be filed within two years of the date of death, and the window is considerably shorter when a city, county, or state agency is involved. Early guidance keeps a deadline from quietly closing a door.

items.title: What Losses the Law Recognizes
items.desc: Recoverable losses can include funeral and burial expenses, the financial support the person would have provided, and the loss of love, companionship, and guidance. An attorney helps document each category rather than leaving it to an insurer's estimate.

items.question: My brother was killed in a crash on Beach Boulevard and the other driver is facing charges. Should we wait for the criminal case to end?
items.answer: You do not have to wait. A wrongful death claim is a civil action that runs on its own track, separate from anything the Orange County District Attorney does. The two-year deadline keeps counting regardless of how the criminal case unfolds, so it is worth speaking with an attorney sooner rather than later. Evidence from the crash can also be easier to gather while it is still fresh.

items.question: I was engaged to the person who died. Can I bring a wrongful death claim in California?
items.answer: Standing in California is limited by statute. A surviving spouse or registered domestic partner and children have priority; certain financially dependent individuals and heirs may qualify in other circumstances. An engagement alone generally does not create standing, but the details of your situation matter, and an attorney can review them with you.

items.question: What if a Buena Park city vehicle or a Caltrans road condition on SR-91 contributed to the death?
items.answer: Claims against a government entity in California follow a different and much shorter process, typically requiring a formal claim within six months before any lawsuit can be filed. Missing that step can end the case before it begins. If you suspect a public agency played any role, mention it right away so the attorney you are connected with can act on the shorter timeline.
